points.title: Right operational costs (low maintenance capex)
points.question: Does the company have right operational costs? The more durable a competitive advantage, the less a business has to spend to maintain it. A simple mathematical formula is to take the amount of earnings retained by a business for a certain period and measure its effect on the earning capacity of the company. If they are building cars or designing software, they may not have to buy big expensive jets, or can use the same equipment for twenty years without any risk of obsolescence. If the answer is yes, be careful.

If the treasuries look juicier, the stock might be overpriced.

points.question: What is the company's projected annual compounding return as an equity/bond?
